name: security.auth.selectedType
description: The currently selected authentication type.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.auth.selectedType behavior.

name: security.auth.enforcedType
description: The required auth type. If this does not match the selected auth type, the user will be prompted to re-authenticate.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.auth.enforcedType behavior.

name: security.auth.useExternal
description: Whether to use an external authentication flow.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.auth.useExternal behavior.

name: security.enableConseca
description: Enable the context-aware security checker. This feature uses an LLM to dynamically generate and enforce security policies for tool use based on your prompt, providing an additional layer of protection against unintended actions.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.enableConseca behavior.

name: advanced.autoConfigureMemory
description: Automatically configure Node.js memory limits. Note: Because memory is allocated during the initial process boot, this setting is only read from the global user settings file and ignores workspace-level overrides.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented advanced.autoConfigureMemory behavior.

name: advanced.dnsResolutionOrder
description: The DNS resolution order.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented advanced.dnsResolutionOrder behavior.

name: advanced.excludedEnvVars
description: Environment variables to exclude from project context.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented advanced.excludedEnvVars behavior.

name: advanced.ignoreLocalEnv
description: Whether to ignore generic .env files in the project directory.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented advanced.ignoreLocalEnv behavior.

name: advanced.bugCommand
description: Configuration for the bug report command.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented advanced.bugCommand behavior.

name: experimental.gemma
description: Enable access to Gemma 4 models via Gemini API.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.gemma behavior.

name: experimental.voiceMode
description: Enable experimental voice dictation and commands (/voice, /voice model).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.voiceMode behavior.

name: experimental.voice.activationMode
description: How to trigger voice recording with the Space key.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.voice.activationMode behavior.

name: experimental.voice.backend
description: The backend to use for voice transcription. Note: When using the Gemini Live backend, voice recordings are sent to Google Cloud for transcription.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.voice.backend behavior.

name: experimental.voice.whisperModel
description: The Whisper model to use for local transcription.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.voice.whisperModel behavior.

name: experimental.voice.stopGracePeriodMs
description: How long to wait for final transcription after stopping recording.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.voice.stopGracePeriodMs behavior.

name: experimental.adk.agentSessionNoninteractiveEnabled
description: Enable non-interactive agent sessions.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.adk.agentSessionNoninteractiveEnabled behavior.

name: experimental.adk.agentSessionInteractiveEnabled
description: Enable the agent session implementation for the interactive CLI.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.adk.agentSessionInteractiveEnabled behavior.

name: experimental.adk.agentSessionSubagentEnabled
description: Route subagent invocations through the AgentSession protocol instead of legacy executors.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.adk.agentSessionSubagentEnabled behavior.
when_not_to_use: Avoid this deprecated setting in new configuration; use the documented replacement when available.

name: experimental.enableAgents
description: Enable local and remote subagents.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.enableAgents behavior.

name: experimental.worktrees
description: Enable automated Git worktree management for parallel work.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.worktrees behavior.

name: experimental.extensionManagement
description: Enable extension management features.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.extensionManagement behavior.

name: experimental.extensionConfig
description: Enable requesting and fetching of extension settings.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.extensionConfig behavior.

name: experimental.extensionRegistry
description: Enable extension registry explore UI.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.extensionRegistry behavior.

name: experimental.extensionRegistryURI
description: The URI (web URL or local file path) of the extension registry.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.extensionRegistryURI behavior.

name: experimental.extensionReloading
description: Enables extension loading/unloading within the CLI session.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.extensionReloading behavior.

name: experimental.useOSC52Paste
description: Use OSC 52 for pasting. This may be more robust than the default system when using remote terminal sessions (if your terminal is configured to allow it).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.useOSC52Paste behavior.

name: experimental.useOSC52Copy
description: Use OSC 52 for copying. This may be more robust than the default system when using remote terminal sessions (if your terminal is configured to allow it).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.useOSC52Copy behavior.

name: experimental.taskTracker
description: Enable task tracker tools.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.taskTracker behavior.

name: experimental.modelSteering
description: Enable model steering (user hints) to guide the model during tool execution.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.modelSteering behavior.

name: experimental.directWebFetch
description: Enable web fetch behavior that bypasses LLM summarization.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.directWebFetch behavior.

name: experimental.dynamicModelConfiguration
description: Enable dynamic model configuration (definitions, resolutions, and chains) via settings.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.dynamicModelConfiguration behavior.

name: experimental.gemmaModelRouter.enabled
description: Enable the Gemma Model Router (experimental). Requires a local endpoint serving Gemma via the Gemini API using LiteRT-LM shim.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.gemmaModelRouter.enabled behavior.

name: experimental.gemmaModelRouter.autoStartServer
description: Automatically start the LiteRT-LM server when Gemini CLI starts and the Gemma router is enabled.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.gemmaModelRouter.autoStartServer behavior.

name: experimental.gemmaModelRouter.binaryPath
description: Custom path to the LiteRT-LM binary. Leave empty to use the default location (~/.gemini/bin/litert/).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.gemmaModelRouter.binaryPath behavior.

name: experimental.gemmaModelRouter.classifier.host
description: The host of the classifier.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.gemmaModelRouter.classifier.host behavior.

name: experimental.gemmaModelRouter.classifier.model
description: The model to use for the classifier. Only tested on gemma3-1b-gpu-custom.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.gemmaModelRouter.classifier.model behavior.

name: experimental.stressTestProfile
description: Significantly lowers token limits to force early garbage collection and distillation for testing purposes.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.stressTestProfile behavior.

name: experimental.autoMemory
description: Automatically extract memory patches and skills from past sessions in the background. Every change is written as a unified diff .patch file under /.inbox// and held for review in /memory inbox; nothing is applied until you approve it.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.autoMemory behavior.

name: experimental.generalistProfile
description: Suitable for general coding and software development tasks.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.generalistProfile behavior.

name: experimental.powerUserProfile
description: Less cache friendly version of the generalist profile.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.powerUserProfile behavior.

name: experimental.contextManagement
description: Enable logic for context management.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.contextManagement behavior.

name: experimental.topicUpdateNarration
description: Deprecated: Use general.topicUpdateNarration instead.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental.topicUpdateNarration behavior.
when_not_to_use: Avoid this deprecated setting in new configuration; use the documented replacement when available.

name: skills.enabled
description: Enable Agent Skills.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented skills.enabled behavior.

name: skills.disabled
description: List of disabled skills.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented skills.disabled behavior.

name: hooksConfig.enabled
description: Canonical toggle for the hooks system. When disabled, no hooks will be executed.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooksConfig.enabled behavior.

name: hooksConfig.disabled
description: List of hook names (commands) that should be disabled. Hooks in this list will not execute even if configured.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooksConfig.disabled behavior.

name: hooksConfig.notifications
description: Show visual indicators when hooks are executing.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooksConfig.notifications behavior.

name: hooks.BeforeTool
description: Hooks that execute before tool execution. Can intercept, validate, or modify tool calls.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.BeforeTool behavior.

name: hooks.AfterTool
description: Hooks that execute after tool execution. Can process results, log outputs, or trigger follow-up actions.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.AfterTool behavior.

name: hooks.BeforeAgent
description: Hooks that execute before agent loop starts. Can set up context or initialize resources.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.BeforeAgent behavior.

name: hooks.AfterAgent
description: Hooks that execute after agent loop completes. Can perform cleanup or summarize results.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.AfterAgent behavior.

name: hooks.Notification
description: Hooks that execute on notification events (errors, warnings, info). Can log or alert on specific conditions.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.Notification behavior.

name: hooks.SessionStart
description: Hooks that execute when a session starts. Can initialize session-specific resources or state.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.SessionStart behavior.

name: hooks.SessionEnd
description: Hooks that execute when a session ends. Can perform cleanup or persist session data.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.SessionEnd behavior.

name: hooks.PreCompress
description: Hooks that execute before chat history compression. Can back up or analyze conversation before compression.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.PreCompress behavior.

name: hooks.BeforeModel
description: Hooks that execute before LLM requests. Can modify prompts, inject context, or control model parameters.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.BeforeModel behavior.

name: hooks.AfterModel
description: Hooks that execute after LLM responses. Can process outputs, extract information, or log interactions.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.AfterModel behavior.

name: hooks.BeforeToolSelection
description: Hooks that execute before tool selection. Can filter or prioritize available tools dynamically.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks.BeforeToolSelection behavior.

name: contextManagement.historyWindow.maxTokens
description: The number of tokens to allow before triggering compression.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented contextManagement.historyWindow.maxTokens behavior.

name: contextManagement.historyWindow.retainedTokens
description: The number of tokens to always retain.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented contextManagement.historyWindow.retainedTokens behavior.

name: contextManagement.messageLimits.normalMaxTokens
description: The target number of tokens to budget for a normal conversation turn.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented contextManagement.messageLimits.normalMaxTokens behavior.

name: contextManagement.messageLimits.retainedMaxTokens
description: The maximum number of tokens a single conversation turn can consume before truncation.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented contextManagement.messageLimits.retainedMaxTokens behavior.

name: contextManagement.messageLimits.normalizationHeadRatio
description: The ratio of tokens to retain from the beginning of a truncated message (0.0 to 1.0).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented contextManagement.messageLimits.normalizationHeadRatio behavior.

name: contextManagement.tools.distillation.maxOutputTokens
description: Maximum tokens to show to the model when truncating large tool outputs.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented contextManagement.tools.distillation.maxOutputTokens behavior.

name: contextManagement.tools.outputMasking.protectLatestTurn
description: Ensures the absolute latest turn is never masked, regardless of token count.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented contextManagement.tools.outputMasking.protectLatestTurn behavior.

name: admin.secureModeEnabled
description: If true, disallows YOLO mode and "Always allow" options from being used.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented admin.secureModeEnabled behavior.

name: admin.extensions.enabled
description: If false, disallows extensions from being installed or used.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented admin.extensions.enabled behavior.

name: admin.mcp.enabled
description: If false, disallows MCP servers from being used.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented admin.mcp.enabled behavior.

name: admin.mcp.config
description: Admin-configured MCP servers (allowlist).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented admin.mcp.config behavior.

name: admin.mcp.requiredConfig
description: Admin-required MCP servers that are always injected.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented admin.mcp.requiredConfig behavior.
